summary: The operation claim digest backfill copies up to 512 claims per page instead of 32, so it commits, and syncs the WAL, about 16 times less often, and it starts two minutes after the APIs serve instead of during the reconnect wave; on a busy member each 32-claim page's commit sync was about three quarters of the backfill's writer hold, up to hundreds of milliseconds a page

schema.detail: No table, trigger or index change. The backfill keeps its table and cursor; a member that is part way through resumes from its cursor.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention, authority or admission rule change. Each page keeps its 20 ms read and write budgets and synchronous=FULL.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version safe: no API, wire, claim or schema change. An older build resuming the same cursor copies the rest in 32-claim pages, as before.

downtime.detail: None. The audit reads claim bodies, as it does now, until the backfill marks itself ready; the two-minute start delay postpones that by two minutes.

recovery.detail: Revert the build as usual; the backfill continues from its cursor in smaller pages.
